basis.note: Which: guesses about how the tendencies in the results you let me see may show in a situation you bring up, read from those results and your words about them. Why: to help you notice your patterns and choose. How: I say each as a guess, with at least one other way to see it; you keep or drop it; I keep in my notes only what you kept, and none is used as a fact about you. When I propose something for you, I may weigh a result you accepted; I name what I weighed, and you say yes or no.
